$schema.purpose: The most shared-config writes (ADR-0019 B4, full scope) each test file may hold. check-aiconfig-test-mutation fails a file above its ceiling; a file not named here has ceiling 0.
$schema.seed: The counts each file held when the ratchet was seeded. Conversions lower them: run `node ai/scripts/lint/check-aiconfig-test-mutation.mjs --tighten-ceilings`, which lowers and drops but never raises or adds.
$schema.raise: Raising a ceiling or adding a file is a hand edit, and reads as one in the diff.
